title: Identification of Autophagy-Associated Molecular Signatures in Osteoarthritis Revealed by Integrative Multi-Omics and Experimental Validation.
authors: Wang, Xiaoqing; Luo, Xingye; Li, Hong; Li, Ting; Wang, Yanyuan; Li, Ruoer; Qing, Yufeng; Zhang, Quanbo
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过多组学和机器学习识别骨关节炎自噬相关分子标志物，核心是疾病诊断与免疫微环境分析，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a complex degenerative disorder characterized by progressive joint deterioration and synovial dysfunction. Emerging evidence implicates autophagy as a key regulatory process in OA development; however, its molecular signatures, diagnostic value, and interaction with the synovial microenvironment remain incompletely defined. This study aimed to delineate autophagy-associated molecular signatures in OA and characterize their biological relevance across bulk and single-cell transcriptomic landscapes. An integrative analytical framework was applied to four synovial bulk transcriptome datasets (GSE55235, GSE12021, GSE55457, and GSE1919) and one single-cell RNA-sequencing dataset (GSE216651) obtained from the GEO database. Autophagy-related genes were curated from publicly available repositories and intersected with differentially expressed genes identified following batch-effect correction and data integration. Key autophagy-associated genes associated with OA were prioritized through weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) combined with multiple machine learning algorithms. Diagnostic utility was assessed using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis and nomogram modeling. Regulatory networks involving upstream microRNAs and transcription factors were inferred in silico. Immune landscape alterations were quantified using ssGSEA, while functional pathways were interrogated by single-gene GSEA. Experimental validation included RT-qPCR analysis in peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs), single-cell resolution mapping of cellular heterogeneity, and ELISA-based quantification of IL-6 with correlation to clinical parameters. Through integrative multi-omics and machine learning analyses, eight autophagy-associated hub genes (XIST, JUN, TNFAIP3, PPP1R15A, IL6, NAMPT, TRAF4, and MYC) were robustly identified as OA-associated molecular features. All candidates demonstrated satisfactory diagnostic performance (AUC > 0.7), which was consistently reproduced in independent validation cohorts and experimental assays. Immune deconvolution revealed widespread alterations in synovial immune cell composition, with significant correlations observed between hub gene expression and nine immune cell populations. Single-cell transcriptomic profiling further uncovered distinct cell-type-specific expression patterns and highlighted intensified fibroblast-macrophage communication networks within OA synovium, suggesting their central involvement in disease progression. By integrating bulk and single-cell transcriptomic analyses with experimental validation, this study defines a set of autophagy-associated molecular markers with diagnostic relevance in osteoarthritis. The identified hub genes not only enhance the understanding of OA-related autophagy dysregulation but also represent potential targets for future mechanistic studies and translational intervention strategies. Importantly, these findings provide a robust molecular framework for early diagnostic screening and risk stratification, potentially facilitating more precise clinical management and personalized therapeutic interventions for OA patients.
abstract_zh: 骨关节炎（OA）是一种复杂的退行性疾病，以进行性关节退化和滑膜功能障碍为特征。新近证据表明自噬（autophagy）是OA发展中的关键调控过程；然而，其分子特征、诊断价值及与滑膜微环境的相互作用仍未完全明确。本研究旨在描绘OA中自噬相关分子特征，并表征其在批量及单细胞转录组图谱中的生物学相关性。应用整合分析框架，对从GEO数据库获取的四个滑膜批量转录组数据集（GSE55235、GSE12021、GSE55457和GSE1919）及一个单细胞RNA测序数据集（GSE216651）进行分析。自噬相关基因从公开存储库中整理，并与批次效应校正和数据整合后鉴定的差异表达基因取交集。通过加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）结合多种机器学习算法，优先筛选出与OA相关的关键自噬基因。诊断效用通过受试者工作特征（ROC）分析和列线图模型评估。涉及上游microRNA和转录因子的调控网络通过计算机模拟推断。免疫景观变化通过ssGSEA量化，而功能通路通过单基因GSEA进行探究。实验验证包括外周血单个核细胞（PBMCs）中的RT-qPCR分析、单细胞分辨率下的细胞异质性图谱，以及基于ELISA的IL-6定量及其与临床参数的相关性分析。通过整合多组学和机器学习分析，八个自噬相关枢纽基因（XIST、JUN、TNFAIP3、PPP1R15A、IL6、NAMPT、TRAF4和MYC）被稳健地鉴定为OA相关分子特征。所有候选基因均表现出满意的诊断性能（AUC > 0.7），并在独立验证队列和实验检测中一致重现。免疫去卷积揭示了滑膜免疫细胞组成的广泛变化，枢纽基因表达与九种免疫细胞群体之间观察到显著相关性。单细胞转录组分析进一步揭示了独特的细胞类型特异性表达模式，并强调了OA滑膜内成纤维细胞-巨噬细胞通讯网络的增强，提示其在疾病进展中的核心参与。通过将批量及单细胞转录组分析与实验验证相结合，本研究定义了一组在骨关节炎中具有诊断相关性的自噬相关分子标记。所鉴定的枢纽基因不仅增强了对OA相关自噬失调的理解，也代表了未来机制研究和转化干预策略的潜在靶点。重要的是，这些发现为早期诊断筛查和风险分层提供了稳健的分子框架，可能促进OA患者更精确的临床管理和个性化治疗干预。
